analysis.summary: Petro Carbon and Chemicals Limited reported its financial performance and business updates for FY 2025 in an investor presentation. Management highlighted that production and sales volumes remained consistent with historical levels despite headwinds from elevated raw material prices. The company also detailed strategic expansions, including the commissioning of a 10 MW WHRB power plant, receipt of environmental clearance for capacity expansion, and the incorporation of new subsidiaries. Furthermore, management noted risks related to import dependency, high energy consumption, and trade restrictions. Petro Carbon and Chemicals Limited reported a significant increase in financial performance for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, with turnover reaching Rs.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the fortune of the CPC industry is closely linked with the fortune of the aluminium industry.
demand_outlook.quote: Fortune of CPC industry is closely linked with the fortune of aluminium industry

demand_outlook.claim: Demand drivers for Calcined Petroleum Coke include rising demand from the steel and aluminium industry.
demand_outlook.quote:  Rising Demand from the Steel and Aluminium Industry.

demand_outlook.claim: Growing environmental regulations and emission control act as market drivers.
demand_outlook.quote:  Growing Environmental Regulations and Emission Control.

demand_outlook.claim: Technological advancements and innovation are key market drivers for Calcined Petroleum Coke.

capex_expansion.claim: A 10 Mega Watt Power Plant was commissioned at the Haldia Factory of the company on 6th March, 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: During the FY 2024-25, 10 Mega Watt Power Plant was commissioned at the Haldia Factory of the Company on 6th March, 2025 and the Company has incurred Capital Expenditure of Rs.7,111.77 lakhs for the same.

capex_expansion.claim: The company received approval from the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change for a proposed expansion project at Haldia.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has got approval of Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Government of India, vide their letter dated 23rd April, 2025, for proposed expansion project of the existing plant located in Haldia, West Bengal by installation of 72,000 TPA Electrically Calcined Anthracite Plant, 60,000 TPA Coal Tar Distillation Plant and 48,000 TPA by revamping of Old Carbon Paste Plant.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the CPC industry faced headwinds in FY 2025 primarily due to elevated raw material prices, which could not be fully passed on to customers and resulted in margin compression.
margins_costs.quote: The CPC industry faced headwinds in FY 2025, primarily due to elevated raw material prices. These increases could not be fully passed on to customers, resulting in margin compression and a weakened bottom line across the sector.

margins_costs.claim: Profit After Tax for FY 2024-25 decreased by 88.51% compared to the previous financial year.
margins_costs.quote: Similarly, the Profit After Tax (PAT) for FY 2024-25 was Rs.947.07 Lakhs as against Rs.8,246.00 Lakhs in FY 2023-24, registering an decrease of 88.51%, for the reasons mentioned above and registering the gross profit margin and consolidated PAT for the FY 2024-25 at Rs.946.28 lakhs.

orders_capacity.claim: The plant has a capacity of approximately 93,744 tons per annum of CPC.
orders_capacity.quote: The Plant has a capacity of approximately 93,744 tons per annum of CPC and the plant comprises an area of around 30 acres with good infrastructure facilities like own railway sliding inside the plant premises itself facilitating unloading / loading of wagons, along with yard / shed to store both Raw Petroleum Coke (RPC) / Calcined Petroleum Coke (CPC).

orders_capacity.claim: Production of Calcined Petroleum Coke for fiscal year 2024-25 was 84,305.500 MT against 91,541.200 MT in financial year 2023-24.
orders_capacity.quote: Production of CPC for fiscal year 2024-25 was 84,305.500 MT against 91,541.200 MT in financial year 2023-24.

capital_allocation.claim: The Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year under review to conserve resources for future expansion and working capital requirements.
capital_allocation.quote: In order to conserve resources for future expansion and working capital requirements, your Directors have decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year under review.

capital_allocation.claim: No amount has been transferred to the reserves by the Board during the year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: No amount has been transferred to the reserves by the Board during the year under review.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted heavy reliance on imports, especially low-sulphur RPC from the U.S., Other Europe, and Asian countries, which affects cost and availability.
risks_headwinds.quote: Heavy reliance on imports (esp. low-sulphur RPC from the U.S. and Other Europe and Asian countries) affects cost and availability.

risks_headwinds.claim: The energy-intensive calcination process raises operational costs, especially during power and fuel inflation.
risks_headwinds.quote: Energy-intensive calcination process raises operational costs, especially during power/fuel inflation.

risks_headwinds.claim: Demand is tied to the aluminium, steel, and battery sectors, each of which is sensitive to economic cycles.
risks_headwinds.quote: Demand tied to aluminium, steel, and battery sectors—each sensitive to economic cycles.

risks_headwinds.claim: Anti-dumping duties or export/import restrictions in key markets impact pricing.
risks_headwinds.quote: Anti-dumping duties or export/import restrictions in key markets (e.g., China, USA and West Asia Market) impact pricing.

risks_headwinds.claim: The Calcined Petroleum Coke industry is constrained by its reliance on imported green petroleum coke, impacting supply stability and costs.
risks_headwinds.quote:  The CPC industry is constrained by its reliance on imported green petroleum coke, impacting supply stability and costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Fluctuations in crude oil prices affect both GPC and CPC prices.
risks_headwinds.quote:  Fluctuations in crude oil prices affect both GPC and CPC prices.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faces foreign exchange risk as it imports more than 90% of its raw materials from foreign suppliers.
risks_headwinds.quote: The company imports more than 90% of its raw materials from foreign suppliers as a result of which the company faces foreign exchange risk.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company adopted a forex policy in June 2023 to ensure 100% hedging.
risks_headwinds.quote: In order to minimize this risk, the company adopted a forex policy in June, 2023 which ensured 100% hedging.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faces raw material risk due to volatility in crude oil cost, stock of RPCs in refineries, and shipping cost.
risks_headwinds.quote: Cost of these imported RPCs are dependent on cost of international crude oil, stock of RPCs in various refineries and shipping cost. Hence, the company faces raw material risk due to volatility in any of these factors.

management_commitments.claim: The company is planning to use Heavy Creosote Oil in place of Furnace Oil during production to achieve substantial savings.
management_commitments.quote: The Company is planning to use Heavy Creosote Oil in place of Furnace Oil during production. There will be substantial saving.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
